gloss: numerous; a great number of; many

definitions.gloss: numerous; a great number of; many
definitions.explanation: A somewhat formal way to express that there are many of something. Functions as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {数多|かずおお}くの{問題|もんだい}がある。
{数多|かずおお}くの{経験|けいけん}を{積|つ}んできた。
examples.english: I have accumulated a great deal of experience.

examples.japanese: この{作家|さっか}は{数多|かずおお}くの{作品|さくひん}を{世|よ}に{送|おく}り{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: This author has produced a great many works.

notes:
{数多|かずおお}くの is a somewhat formal way to say "many" or "numerous," more literary and emphatic than {多|おお}くの or たくさんの.

USAGE:
- Always modifies a noun: {数多|かずおお}くの{問題|もんだい} (numerous problems)
- Can also be used adverbially without の: {数多|かずおお}く{存在|そんざい}する (to exist in large numbers)

ALTERNATE READING:
{数多|あまた} — a more literary/archaic reading with the same meaning. {数多|あまた}の{困難|こんなん} (numerous hardships).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たくさんの: lots of (casual, everyday)
- {多|おお}くの: many (neutral)
- {数多|かずおお}くの: numerous (formal, emphatic)
- {無数|むすう}の: countless (strongest)

REGISTER:
Written language, speeches, and formal contexts. Rare in casual conversation.
